desc:
🥟 Climb the Keyboard Dumpling Tower, a cute Squishy Dumpling ASMR obby! Run from bouncy dumplings, hide in pots and win a crate at the top!

🍭 CLIMB sweet keyboard levels: Candy, Chocolate, Honey, Cookie, Ice Cream, Pancake and more. Each one has its own dumpling!
🎧 RELAX with clicky ASMR keyboard sounds on every step
🏃 RUN from cute squishy dumplings. They get faster on every level!
🍲 HIDE in a pot to be safe. Dumplings can't get you there
🐾 SQUISH your dumpling pet to get stars
🎁 OPEN crates for 90+ cute pets, slap gloves, trails and pots
🔁 SQUISHY TRADING: trade dumpling pets, gloves and more with friends
👋 SLAP friends on the tower, 💃 DANCE for free
👑 WIN to become King of the tower and top the Wins leaderboard

😌 A cozy, chill keyboard tower obby. Play alone or with friends!

🎁 Free gifts every day, more gifts the longer you play, and codes!
📱💻🎮 Phone, PC, tablet and console

🎟 Use code RELEASE
❓ Where do I redeem codes? Tap the Codes button, top right.
